title: Project Stark | Free
features:
⚡ PROJECT STARK — MURDER MYSTERY 2 ⚡

🪙 COINS
• Coin ESP — highlights every coin on the map
• Auto Collect — always glides to the closest coin
• Collect Speed slider

👁️ VISUALS
• Player ESP — role-colored highlights
• Role Labels — Murderer / Sheriff / Innocent above heads
• Tracers — smooth, updated every frame
• Names — separate toggle, works with tracers off
• Max Range slider

🔫 COMBAT
• Aimbot — Aim Speed, FOV, FOV Circle, Wall Check, Prediction
• Gun ESP — see every dropped gun
• Gun Tag — gun name shown above each dropped gun
• Auto Grab Gun + Grab Speed
• Go To Dropped Gun

🏃 MOVEMENT
• Walk Speed — minimum is your real default speed
• Jump Power + Infinite Jump
• Fly + Fly Speed
• Noclip — fully reversible
• Reset Character

🧰 UTILITY
• Snitch — announce Murderer / Sheriff / All in chat
• Redeem All Codes
• Music Player — song ID + volume
• Anti-AFK · Anti-Fling · Anti-Lag
• Rejoin / Server Hop

🎨 UI
• Clean menu with a built-in Config system — save, load & delete configs per game
• Menu keybind (default: Home) and Unload button
